page.layout: One column of index entries, headed by a running title "INDEX" with page number "xi" at the top. Entries run from "Oxygala" down to "Panis utilitas maxima", with a letter "P." above the P entries. Gathering signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.l: Panis bordeaceus à cibis non abdicandus 217
Pane ex bordeo vescentes podagrâ non tentan-tur 217
Panes leguminosi, filiquacei, pomati, cerasati, nucleati, amygdalini, sambuci, piscini, ouati, &c. 219. & seqq.

page.notes: The numeral after "Oxygala vires" is hard to read and may be 580 or another value; it is marked [?]. "Siligunitis" may be "silignitis" in print; I copied the letters as they appear. The "P" initial is a large letter joined to "Alumbium". Index entries are given without a column layout, as lines with page numbers at the end.
